name: ha-nova
description: AI-powered Home Assistant management through LLM coding agents
author: Markus Leben

scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('nova/dist', { recursive: true, force: true });" && tsc -p nova/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:desktop:windows:headless: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& { if (-not $env:HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_URL) { throw 'HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_URL is required' }; if (-not $env:HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_SHA256_URL) { throw 'HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_SHA256_URL is required' }; & './scripts/dev/windows-private-rc-install.ps1' -BundleUrl $env:HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_URL -BundleSha256Url $env:HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_SHA256_URL }"
scripts.test:desktop:windows:public: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& { if (-not $env:HA_NOVA_INSTALL_SOURCE) { $env:HA_NOVA_INSTALL_SOURCE = 'stable' }; if (-not $env:HA_NOVA_START_STATE) { $env:HA_NOVA_START_STATE = 'clean' }; $params = @{ InstallSource = $env:HA_NOVA_INSTALL_SOURCE; StartState = $env:HA_NOVA_START_STATE }; if ($env:HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_URL) { $params.BundleUrl = $env:HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_URL }; if ($env:HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_SHA256_URL) { $params.BundleSha256Url = $env:HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_SHA256_URL }; if ($env:HA_NOVA_REQUIRE_ANTIGRAVITY_DESKTOP_ONLY) { $params.RequireAntigravityDesktopOnly = $true }; & './scripts/dev/windows-public-onboarding.ps1' @params }"
scripts.test:desktop:windows:rdp: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& { if (-not $env:HA_NOVA_CLIENT) { $env:HA_NOVA_CLIENT = 'claude' }; if (-not $env:HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_URL) { throw 'HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_URL is required' }; if (-not $env:HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_SHA256_URL) { throw 'HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_SHA256_URL is required' }; & './scripts/dev/windows-desktop-setup.ps1' -Client $env:HA_NOVA_CLIENT -BundleUrl $env:HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_URL -BundleSha256Url $env:HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_SHA256_URL }"
scripts.test:desktop:windows:antigravity: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& { if (-not $env:HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_URL) { throw 'HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_URL is required' }; if (-not $env:HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_SHA256_URL) { throw 'HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_SHA256_URL is required' }; & './scripts/dev/windows-desktop-setup.ps1' -Client antigravity -BundleUrl $env:HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_URL -BundleSha256Url $env:HA_NOVA_BUNDLE_SHA256_URL }"
scripts.test:bulk:fast: npm run test:safe -- tests/skills/bulk-audit-contract.test.ts tests/skills/review-contract.test.ts tests/skills/ha-entities-contract.test.ts tests/skills/ha-safety-contract.test.ts tests/skills/ha-nova-contract.test.ts tests/e2e/codex-skill-bulk-live-validator.test.ts
scripts.test:bulk:release: npm run test:bulk:fast && npm run test:bulk:smoke && npm run test:safe
scripts.verify:onboarding: npm run verify:installers && npx vitest run tests/onboarding/install-skills-per-client.test.ts tests/onboarding/dev-sync-contract.test.ts tests/onboarding/dev-sync-behavior.test.ts tests/onboarding/claude-plugin-state-helper.test.ts tests/onboarding/installer-contract.test.ts tests/onboarding/relay-cli-contract.test.ts tests/onboarding/self-update-contract.test.ts tests/onboarding/platform-dispatch.test.ts tests/onboarding/linux-keyring-contract.test.ts tests/onboarding/macos-keyring-contract.test.ts tests/onboarding/windows-keyring-interop-contract.test.ts tests/onboarding/legacy-cleanup-contract.test.ts tests/onboarding/onboarding-skill-contract.test.ts tests/onboarding/go-runtime-contract.test.ts tests/onboarding/safe-test-system-contract.test.ts tests/onboarding/bump-version.test.ts
scripts.verify:release-contracts: npm run verify:release-metadata && npx vitest run tests/onboarding/release-contract.test.ts tests/onboarding/desktop-validation-contract.test.ts tests/onboarding/desktop-validation-behavior.test.ts tests/onboarding/dependabot-automation-contract.test.ts
scripts.verify: npm run verify:security && bash scripts/release/verify-blocked-files.sh && npm run typecheck && npm run verify:docs && npm run test:safe:core && npm run verify:onboarding && npm run build && npm run test:cli && npm run verify:release-contracts
